intended.name: Acorn
intended.placement: On soil or in a little collection tray
intended.interaction: Hop over, lift, turn to examine, then plant or collect
intended.outcome: Acorn enters soil or tray; later sprout or collection persists

intended.name: Balloon
intended.placement: Tied to a low post with visible string
intended.interaction: Untie, hold string, walk/hop with buoyant balloon, retie
intended.outcome: String stays attached; balloon trails and settles at new support

intended.name: Beachball
intended.interaction: Approach, nudge, chase, stop it with a second contact
intended.outcome: Ball rolls, slows, and rests; play has a clear endpoint

intended.name: Broom
intended.interaction: Fetch and sweep visible debris
intended.outcome: Debris collects; broom returns to support

intended.name: Cake
intended.placement: On a small plate or stand
intended.interaction: Approach, blow candles, take a small serving
intended.outcome: Flames extinguish; serving visibly changes; plate is cleared

intended.name: Candy
intended.interaction: Pick up, unwrap, taste, collect wrapper
intended.outcome: Wrapper and candy states differ; litter is removed

intended.name: Canister
intended.interaction: Open and use contents appropriate to its actual identity
intended.outcome: Lid and contents change; close and store; first verify what current art represents

intended.name: Clock
intended.placement: Mounted or on a stable stand
intended.interaction: Approach and wind or adjust it; respond when it rings
intended.outcome: Hands/bell react; Jelly begins a related routine

intended.name: Cloud
intended.placement: In sky, clearly distinct from a solid toy
intended.interaction: Visit a viewing spot; follow drift and respond to its shadow or drizzle
intended.outcome: Shadow or rain changes ground; Jelly seeks cover or enjoys the clearing

intended.name: Clover
intended.placement: Rooted in a small soil patch
intended.interaction: Tend, gently inspect leaves, water
intended.outcome: Leaves lift or growth state improves; plant stays rooted

intended.name: Cocoa
intended.placement: On a coaster or low table
intended.interaction: Lift, blow steam, sip, return
intended.outcome: Steam and liquid diminish; cup returns to coaster

cocoa.review: Initial native stage contact sheets inspected: cup travels to grip and liquid drains; sip pose and mouth contact refinement pending.

intended.name: Crescent
intended.placement: Celestial, not a loose floor object
intended.interaction: Visit telescope or viewing spot and track moon
intended.outcome: Telescope aims; reflection or moonlight scene responds; bedtime follows

intended.name: Diya
intended.interaction: Carry/set tray, carefully tend wick, admire light
intended.outcome: Flame and local glow change; tray remains supported

intended.name: Dreidel
intended.interaction: Pick up, set, spin, follow wobble
intended.outcome: Spin slows, tips, and rests; Jelly retrieves it

intended.name: Eggs
intended.interaction: Lift/turn one and decorate or arrange
intended.outcome: Egg pattern/arrangement changes; egg returns to basket

intended.name: Fan
intended.placement: On stand or held with a proper grip
intended.interaction: Switch on/adjust or use hand fan according to design
intended.outcome: Blades/folds move; nearby ribbon and Jelly react to airflow

intended.name: Feast
intended.interaction: Arrange a place, sit, take a portion, tidy
intended.outcome: Portions change and setting is packed away

intended.name: Flower
intended.placement: Rooted or in a supported pot
intended.interaction: Water, smell with visible lean, remove a fallen petal
intended.outcome: Bloom/leaf state changes; petal is collected

intended.name: Fountain
intended.interaction: Approach edge, dip/fill a small container, water a plant
intended.outcome: Ripples and container water connect fountain to another task

intended.name: Gift
intended.interaction: Carry to open space, untie, open
intended.outcome: Revealed usable item joins play; wrapping is folded away

intended.name: Globe
intended.interaction: Approach, spin with contact, stop and examine a point
intended.outcome: Globe rotates and slows; chosen location becomes a short thought/memory

intended.name: Grass
intended.interaction: Tend or trim a patch using an appropriate tool
intended.outcome: Patch height changes; clippings collect

intended.name: Heart
intended.placement: Explicit tangible token/cushion, or explicit effect
intended.interaction: Carry token to a keepsake place or hug a cushion
intended.outcome: Token is stored or cushion compresses; avoid unexplained floating solid heart

intended.name: Icicles
intended.interaction: Notice drip, place a bowl beneath, return later
intended.outcome: Drops accumulate; icicle slowly shortens; no floating ice sticks

intended.name: Kite
intended.placement: Folded on ground or stored on rack
intended.interaction: Fetch, unfold, run/hop to launch, hold spool, reel in
intended.outcome: Kite responds to wind; string remains connected; folds for storage

intended.name: Lamp
intended.interaction: Approach switch, turn on, settle nearby for quiet activity
intended.outcome: Light changes and supports reading/rest; switch off afterward

intended.name: Lantern
intended.interaction: Carry by handle and hang at a destination
intended.outcome: Swing settles from attachment; local lighting changes

intended.name: Leaf
intended.placement: On ground after a visible fall
intended.interaction: Catch or collect; add to pile or press in a keepsake
intended.outcome: Leaf moves through contact and ends in a deliberate location

intended.name: Lemonade
intended.interaction: Pick up and sip, then return
intended.outcome: Liquid level falls; glass stays upright and returns to support

intended.name: Letter
intended.placement: On mat or in a small mailbox
intended.interaction: Collect, open, unfold, read, fold and store
intended.outcome: Envelope/paper states and keepsake storage are visible

intended.name: Menorah
intended.interaction: Approach and tend/display lights with an appropriate gesture
intended.outcome: Correct modeled lights and subtle illumination; verify cultural depiction

intended.name: Mittens
intended.placement: On a rack or folded pair
intended.interaction: Fetch, put on before cold play, remove afterward
intended.outcome: Wearable attachments follow Jelly; mittens return as a pair

intended.name: Music
intended.placement: Define source: instrument or music box; notes are effects
intended.interaction: Operate the source, play a short rhythm, dance to it
intended.outcome: Source movement produces timed notes; stop and close/store source

intended.name: Pie
intended.interaction: Approach, smell steam, take a slice/portion
intended.outcome: Pie visibly changes; plate and crumbs are cleared

intended.name: Pinwheel
intended.interaction: Pick up, blow, then hold in breeze
intended.outcome: Spin rate follows blowing/wind and decays; return stem to holder

intended.name: Popsicle
intended.interaction: Lift and taste while holding stick
intended.outcome: Treat shrinks slightly; drip and stick are handled

intended.name: Pot
intended.placement: Supported pot with identity clarified from art
intended.interaction: Plant into a planter, or stir a cooking pot if that is its identity
intended.outcome: Soil/plant or contents change; do not mix incompatible meanings

intended.name: Powder
intended.interaction: Scoop/sprinkle or brush into a pattern
intended.outcome: Material transfers and leaves a shaped result; avoid generic mystery pixels

intended.name: Puddle
intended.interaction: Approach, test with a toe, hop through, shake droplets
intended.outcome: Contact produces ripples/splash; puddle gradually dries

intended.name: Pumpkin
intended.placement: Grounded on patch or low stand
intended.interaction: Roll into place, clean, decorate
intended.outcome: Face/pattern changes; pumpkin remains supported

intended.name: Rake
intended.placement: Head grounded, handle against visible support
intended.interaction: Fetch, carry, rake contacting leaves, return
intended.outcome: Leaves form pile; tool rests against support again

rake.review: Initial native stage contact sheets inspected: travel and tool support visible; contact, return and pile-play refinement pending.

intended.name: Rangoli
intended.interaction: Carry colors and place successive strokes/dots
intended.outcome: Pattern visibly develops; excess material is tidied respectfully

intended.name: Rocket
intended.placement: Clearly a toy on a launch base
intended.interaction: Position toy, trigger launch, watch, retrieve landed toy
intended.outcome: Authored launch arc and landing; no unexplained perpetual hover

intended.name: Sandcastle
intended.placement: On sand patch with small bucket
intended.interaction: Fetch sand, pack/invert bucket, pat towers
intended.outcome: Castle grows through discrete stages; tools are stored

intended.name: Scythe
intended.interaction: Carry with controlled pose and harvest a grass patch
intended.outcome: Grass becomes gathered cuttings; tool returns safely to rack

intended.name: Seedling
intended.interaction: Fetch water, pour at roots, inspect
intended.outcome: Moisture and growth state change over later visits

intended.name: Sled
intended.interaction: Pull by rope to start, sit, slide, step off, retrieve
intended.outcome: Sled travels along a valid local slope/path and comes to rest

intended.name: Snowangel
intended.placement: Result drawn into snow, not a floating item
intended.interaction: Hop to fresh snow, lie back, sweep limbs/body, rise
intended.outcome: Matching imprint remains; Jelly looks back at its work

intended.name: Snowball
intended.interaction: Roll to grow, lift or push toward snowman/play target
intended.outcome: Size/position changes; ball is incorporated or breaks into snow

intended.name: Snowflake
intended.interaction: Move to catch it and hold still to inspect
intended.outcome: Flake lands at contact point and melts to a droplet

intended.name: Snowman
intended.interaction: Roll and stack balls, add recognizable details
intended.outcome: Build stages persist; Jelly revisits or repairs later

intended.name: Sweets
intended.interaction: Select a piece, taste, offer/arrange remaining pieces
intended.outcome: Count/arrangement changes; bowl remains supported

intended.name: Telescope
intended.interaction: Hop over, approach eyepiece, adjust aim, observe
intended.outcome: Tube tracks an actual sky target; Jelly withdraws coherently

intended.name: Train
intended.placement: Wheels on short track or flat floor
intended.interaction: Set on track, push, follow, stop and return
intended.outcome: Wheels and translation agree; train rests at a small station

intended.name: Tree
intended.interaction: Water roots, collect fallen material, hang a small keepsake
intended.outcome: Tree condition or decoration changes and remains visible

intended.name: Window
intended.interaction: Approach latch, open/close, look out, wipe condensation
intended.outcome: Pane state controls breeze/rain entry and view; no free-floating frame

intended.name: Windsock
intended.interaction: Approach, raise or adjust it, observe before flying kite
intended.outcome: Fabric responds to wind and informs Jelly’s next activity
